hub.intro: The admin areas your roles open, the work waiting on you, feature flags and the contact inbox. Every change here is recorded in the audit log.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.intro: Switch demo features on or off for everyone. Locked flags protect rules that must not change, such as no telemetry on the speak-up page.
flags.readOnly: Only a platform admin can change flags.

inbox.title: Contact requests
inbox.intro: Requests from the public contact form, routed to role mailboxes. Kept for 180 days, then due for deletion.

reset.title: Demo data
reset.body: Restore the local demo tenant to its seeded state. This clears every change made in this browser: applications, sign-offs, flags, Dalil logs and audit entries.
reset.consequence: All local demo changes in this browser are discarded and the seeded data is restored. Other browsers are not affected.
reset.live: The live backend reads ENEC NEXUS data and kafaa_* tables in the shared project. It cannot be reset from here; switch to the local demo to reset.

fw.intro: Job families and roles, competencies and versioned qualification standards. Revising a standard creates a new version and flags affected records for review.
fw.regulatedEdit: Regulated role ({ref}): entry requirements follow the regulation and are not edited here.
fw.reasonHint: Saving creates a new role version; the change is recorded in the audit log.
fw.standardsIntro: Standards are versioned. Only the current version is used for new qualifications; superseded versions stay for history. Task lists are edited in the standard editor.
fw.reviseBody: A new version takes effect today. The current version becomes superseded and every active qualification against it is flagged for review.

content.intro: Pages and news move from draft to translation, review and publication. A page publishes only with both languages approved, sources for every factual claim and a review date.
content.title: Title
content.ecpTitle: Owned by the Employee Concerns Program
content.ecpBody: The ECP owns this wording. Editors cannot change or unpublish it here.
content.noClaims: No factual claims, so no sources needed.

block.sources: Every factual claim cites a source

content.publishBody: "{title}" goes live for its audience. The publication is recorded in the audit log.
content.unpublishBody: "{title}" is removed from the site and returns to draft.
content.liveEdit: This page is live. Changing its text sends it back through translation and review.
content.slugRule: Use lower-case letters, numbers, hyphens and slashes
content.bodyArHint: The translator completes this before review.
content.noClaimsLabel: This page makes no factual claims
content.noClaimsHint: For example a privacy notice or navigation page.
content.rules: No real staff names or photos, no plant procedures, security arrangements or site layouts, and no projected headcounts.
content.factsIntro: Every public statistic shows its value, source and "as of" date, or a SAMPLE label. Facts older than a year are marked stale.
content.factNeedsSource: A public fact needs a source unless it is marked SAMPLE.
content.conflictHint: Where sources disagree, say which figure is shown and why.
content.question: Question
content.sourcesIntro: Every source cited on Kafa'a is registered here with its publisher and the date it was accessed. Only public HTTPS pages are accepted.
content.cataloguesIntro: Courses belong to Nuclear Training and partner records to Partnerships. They are shown here for review; edit them in their owners' areas.

int.intro: Connectors to the systems of record. Each has a freshness threshold; a stale licence or medical mirror stops the portal showing "valid".

consequence.sync: A simulated sync runs now and updates the last-success time. Open reconciliation errors stay open.
consequence.disable: Kafa'a stops reading this system. Records mirrored from it become stale after the threshold and the portal stops showing them as valid.
consequence.enable: Kafa'a resumes reading this system on its schedule.

int.staleBody: {names}: past the freshness threshold. Licence and medical views show "status not confirmed" instead of "valid" after {h} hours.
int.footer: In the demo, connectors are simulated; no external system is called.

int-hr.name: HR system of record
int-hr.notes: Joiner, mover and leaver events; leavers lose access within one sync cycle.

int-trs.name: Training records system
int-trs.notes: Kafa'a mirrors qualification records until ENEC approves it as the system of record. 3 reconciliation errors open.

int-octs.name: Licensee certification records (OCTS mirror)
int-octs.notes: FANR records decisions in OCTS; Kafa'a mirrors status from the licensee's certification records.

int-roster.name: Shift roster feed (counts only)
int-roster.notes: Counts only; no rosters or crew composition.

int-ohs.name: Occupational health (flag only)
int-ohs.domain: medical due dates and fit flag
int-ohs.notes: Stale: last success more than 72 hours ago. Medical flags show "not yet confirmed".

int-careers.name: ENEC careers channel
int-careers.notes: Vacancies link out to the official careers channel.

int-lms.name: E-learning (xAPI)
int-lms.notes: 12 statements rejected for unknown activity ids.

int-nexus-ledger.name: ENEC NEXUS evidence ledger
int-nexus-ledger.notes: Consequential actions append to nexus_append_ledger, plane PEOPLE.

int-nexus-partner.name: NEXUS partner lens hand-off
int-nexus-partner.notes: Ready suppliers hand off to /partner/readiness in NEXUS.

int-uaepass.name: UAE Pass (concept)
int-uaepass.domain: verified identity when a stage needs it
int-uaepass.notes: Not connected in the demo tenant.

int-lrs.name: External learning record store (xAPI 2.0)
int-lrs.domain: xAPI statements forwarded from the Kafa'a store
int-lrs.notes: Adapter described in Training > Learning record store > Adapters. No public endpoint in the demo; statements stay in Kafa'a (https://kafaa.example accounts, no email).

nexus.intro: Kafa'a is the people and skills layer next to ENEC NEXUS. These are the seven agreed integration points, read-only mirrors of NEXUS role cards and the authority matrix, and the evidence ledger entries Kafa'a has appended.
nexus.notAuthority: Kafa'a mirrors who decides; it never decides or changes the authority matrix. Licensing decisions stay with FANR, employment decisions with ENEC and Nawah.
nexus.mSkippedSub: Kafa'a-only personas have no NEXUS profile

roles.title: Role pages and role cards
roles.body: Career pages read NEXUS role cards and their "Decides" lines so roles match how ENEC describes them.

quals.title: Qualification outcomes
quals.body: NEXUS talent views receive qualification outcomes (qualified, due, expired), never the underlying records.

catalogue.title: One learning catalogue
catalogue.body: Training programmes and courses in NEXUS and Kafa'a should be one catalogue; the owner is still to be agreed.

readiness.title: Supplier readiness hand-off
readiness.body: When a supplier is ready to register, Kafa'a hands off to the NEXUS partner readiness lens.

partners.title: Shared organisation records
partners.body: The partners directory reads shared organisation and partnership records instead of keeping its own copy.

ledger.title: Evidence ledger
ledger.body: Material actions in Kafa'a append to the NEXUS evidence ledger with the same hash scheme.

identity.title: Identity and language
identity.body: Kafa'a reuses the NEXUS role-card session and should share the EN/AR preference (to be agreed).

d.roles: {p} role cards and {a} reserved decisions read
d.quals: Outcome feed specified; awaiting agreement with the NEXUS owner.
d.readiness: Hand-off link used from supplier onboarding.
d.identity: Role-card session reused; language preference stays in Kafa'a for now.

nexus.linksNote: These pages belong to ENEC NEXUS and open in the same window.
nexus.linksOff: Links into NEXUS are switched off by a feature flag.
nexus.personasIntro: NEXUS role cards as published by NEXUS, with the Kafa'a roles each card maps to. Read-only.
nexus.authorityIntro: The NEXUS authority matrix, mirrored for reference. Kafa'a shows who decides; it does not decide.
nexus.mirrorNote: Mirror of the NEXUS authority matrix. Changes are made in NEXUS by its owner.
nexus.ledgerIntro: Entries Kafa'a appended to the NEXUS evidence ledger (plane PEOPLE, domain KAFAA). Each entry chains to the one before it.
nexus.noLedgerBody: Material actions such as sign-offs, role grants and access reviews appear here.

audit.intro: Every write and every refusal, in order. Entries are hash-chained and cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.appendOnly: Append-only: the database rejects any change or deletion of an audit entry, and this console has no edit or delete control.
audit.noEdit: Audit entries cannot be changed. To correct a record, make a new entry through the normal workflow.

ai.intro: How every recommendation in Kafa'a works, what it never uses, whether its outcomes are fair across groups, and every change to its settings. All engines are deterministic and explain each result; no model is connected.
ai.footerTitle: What this page is, and is not
ai.footerBody: A governance view of Kafa'a's own suggestion engines on a synthetic demo population. It makes no decision about anyone: suggestions inform people and managers, and HR and line managers decide. A flag starts a review; it does not change anyone's results.

stat.cardsSub: {n} can be switched off by each person
stat.protectedSub: Gender, nationality and age: checked by an automated test on every build
stat.optouts: Opted out of the Learning Coach
stat.optoutsSub: People who switched ranked suggestions off

cards.intro: One card per surface that ranks or scores. Weights are live from the engine settings; a change to them gives every card on that engine a new version.

card.neverTested: No scoring function reads these fields: checked by an automated test on every build.
card.optOutYes: Each person can switch it off
card.functions: For auditors: the {n} functions behind this card

metricHelp.navigator_ready: Share of staff with at least one role within two steps rated "ready now" or "ready within 3 years" (people who switched the Navigator off are left out).
metricHelp.opportunity_selected: Share of applicants selected for (or who completed) at least one opportunity.
metricHelp.mentoring_matched: Share of people who asked for mentoring and were matched.
metricHelp.hipo_pool: Share of staff in the high-potential pool (talent review placements when present, else the leadership pipeline the pool feeds).

fair.howBody: Each week Kafa'a compares outcome rates between women and men, and between Emirati and other nationalities. A group whose rate is below {pct}% of the best group's rate is flagged (the four-fifths rule). If any group has fewer than 10 people the whole comparison is suppressed, so no small group can be worked out by subtraction. People with no recorded value are left out of that comparison.
fair.noneBody: Run the weekly snapshot to compare outcomes across groups.
fair.resultsDesc: Outcomes as of {date}. Bars show each group's rate; the line marks four-fifths of the best rate.
fair.suppressedBody: A group has fewer than 10 people, so this comparison is not shown (no counts, no rates, no flag).
fair.trendTitle: Lowest group ratio per metric, by week
fair.trendBody: The lowest group rate as a percentage of the best group's rate (shown comparisons only). Below the dashed line is a flag.
fair.flagBody: AI governance and HR review the engine card, the inputs and the human decisions behind the outcome within two weeks, and record what they found in the change log if weights change. No individual result is changed by the monitor, and the flag alone is not evidence of discrimination.
fair.confirmBody: Kafa'a recomputes this week's outcome rates for every group, replaces this week's rows and records the run in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.

log.intro: Every change to an engine or its weights, with before and after, the rationale, and its audit and NEXUS ledger entries.
log.noRationale: No rationale (switched from the integrations card)

weights.noModel: No model gateway is configured, so the deterministic engine keeps serving and the surface shows "model unavailable".
weights.title: Weights (0 to 10)
weights.none: This engine has no adjustable weights.
weights.range: Each weight must be a number from 0 to 10.
weights.rationaleHint: At least {n} characters: why the change, and what evidence supports it.
weights.confirmBody: The new settings apply at once to every surface on this engine. Each card on it gets a new version, and the change is written to the change log, the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.

opt.title: Opt-outs by surface
opt.body: People who switched ranked suggestions off. Each person decides on their settings page; nobody else sees who.
opt.requestsHidden: Visible to platform admins and auditors.
opt.requestsNote: Handled through the data rights queue with the same 30-day target as every other request.

optedOut.title: You switched off {surface} suggestions

body.coach: No ranked learning cards are shown. Here is the full staff catalogue in plain order; your mandatory training is still assigned as usual.
body.navigator: No readiness ranking is shown. Here are the published roles by job family; the career paths show every route.
body.marketplace: No match scores or top picks are shown. Opportunities are listed by start date.

optedOut.note: You can switch it back on at any time.

unranked.catalogueBody: All staff courses by code. Nothing here is ranked for you.
unranked.rolesBody: Every published role, alphabetical. Nothing here is rated for you.

settings.title: Recommendations and your data
settings.intro: Kafa'a's suggestions come from deterministic engines that explain every result. They never use your gender, nationality or age. You can switch ranked suggestions off on each surface below; the full lists stay available.

offBody.navigator: You see the roles and career paths without a readiness ranking.
offBody.coach: You see the course catalogue in plain order instead of ranked learning cards.
offBody.marketplace: You see opportunities by start date, without match scores.

settings.othersBody: These suggest only when you ask (mentors, rotations, experts, Future Me) or support a human decision (talent review). They have no personal switch; you can read how each works and ask for a correction.
settings.export: Download what Kafa'a infers about me (JSON)
settings.never: Your choices are recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger. HR and admins see only how many people switched a surface off, never who.

consequenceOff.navigator: The Career Navigator stops rating your readiness for roles and shows the roles and paths in plain order instead.
consequenceOff.coach: The Learning Coach stops ranking learning for you and shows the course catalogue in plain order. Mandatory training is still assigned.
consequenceOff.marketplace: The marketplace stops scoring opportunities for you and lists them by start date. You can still apply to any opportunity.

settings.consequenceOn: Ranked suggestions with their reasons come back on this surface.

export.done: Your AI inferences file is downloaded
export.failed: The file could not be prepared. Try again.
export.logged: Self-service export: what Kafa'a infers about me (AI inferences)

correct.title: Ask for a correction
correct.intro: Tell us which inference looks wrong, for example a skill level, a piece of evidence or a readiness rating. A person reviews it; nothing changes automatically.
correct.hint: Name the skill, record or role, and what you believe is right.
correct.sla: Answered within 30 days through the data rights process, like every other request.
